headline: Clean again — 5 uploads, 28 runs, 0 failures — but analytics only reach Nov 14 and PR #8 is still waiting on your preview check.
happened: Tue Nov 17: 2 single Shorts uploaded (Psychic-type, Electric-type) and 3 rapid-fires (Then & Now cries, Dragon-type, a 7-sound Pokémon Mix at 54 s), all public on YouTube and cross-posted to Instagram and Facebook. Two more renders (Grass-type Ep. 78 at 17:46 UTC, Slowed-down cries at 17:52 UTC) have no YouTube link in the Episode log. 28 workflow runs since yesterday's brief, all green; Run failures is empty.

Analytics job ran at 16:25 UTC Nov 17 (about 9 h after its 06:40 cron); data now runs through Nov 14. Nov 14 was the biggest day in the window: 4,902 views, +6/−2 subscribers. Nov 8–14 total 21,351 views. Channel: 55 subscribers (was 54), 56,614 views (was 54,176), 156 videos (was 150). The nightly job has not fired yet today (last analytics run: Nov 17 16:25 UTC).
Judge: no new decisions. Captions stays crowned static (Nov 13); the active test is cta. Standings moved a little: cry og 73.4 vs modern 71.0 (n=15/18), series numbered 77.6 vs plain 69.8 (n=6/5).

Single Shorts from Nov 14–16 are bimodal: Psychic 10, Gen 1 19, Fire Ep. 73 4, Starter 10, Water Ep. 72 11 views, against Bug 637, Dragon 862, Electric 621 and 846, Gen 4 704 and 881, Legendary 707. Ages differ by 1–4 days, but the weak ones are the low-fitness themes (Starter, Water, Gen 1 at 0.4; Fire 0.56).

Two commits to main since yesterday's brief: the TTS length check now also covers the trimmed clip (re-synthesises if cut off), and the daily.yml run artifact now holds only that run's files. PR #8 (new formats) is still open, not merged.

decisions.title: Reopen the captions decision? It was a tie on retention and static reaches 34 % fewer viewers.
decisions.why: The judge crowned static at the sample cap on a 3 % lead (bar is 10 %) and bypassed the views guard. The rule is fixed for future tests; this one needs a human call.
options: Reopen and keep kinetic as baseline (incumbent on a tie)
Leave static; carry kinetic's gold highlight and chunked Pokédex into static as a new test
decisions.recommendation: Reopen and keep kinetic as baseline (incumbent on a tie)
decisions.how: Reply in chat; it's a one-line edit to state/experiments.json.

ideas: Themes at the 0.4 fitness floor with n≥3 for Shorts (Starter n=4, median 97.5 views; Generation 1 n=3, median 41; Generation 2 n=5, median 98) still get drawn while Dragon (median 737.5) and Electric (621) sit at 2.0+; pausing the floor themes for Shorts for a week would test whether those slots do better on the strong ones.

Rapid-fire themes outperform the same themes as single Shorts at the low end (Starter rapid median 148 views vs Starter Short 97.5; Generation 1 rapid 229 vs Short 41) — the rapid format may be the better home for weak themes.
